precepts.text: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low. He shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail. That curse was on us in ancient Egypt: the Egyptians were over us and we were the bottom of society, the same way the nations are above us today and we are the bottom of society. The one above you, ruling and telling you what to do, is also called a taskmaster.
precepts.point: All manner of service: we were their servants, cooking their food, watching their kids, entertaining them, singing for them. Sing us one of the songs of Zion. It is the same in America: the service jobs, the entertainment. We are kings and priests; we are not supposed to serve any nation. Our job is to serve God. But we have been slaves so long we got comfortable with the jobs they give us to do.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

precepts.why:
Exodus 1:11 says “they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens.” Deuteronomy 28 names that as a curse: “The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low. He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.”

The strangers are the people that were amongst us. They get above us very high, and we come down very low. To be above us means they rule and tell us what to do, and another name for that is taskmaster.

That curse was on us in ancient Egypt: the Egyptians were over us, and we were on the bottom of society. It is the same way the so-called white man and the nations are above us today, and we are the bottom of society. The taskmasters today are the governors, the politicians, the police officers, the FBI agents, people set to keep us in check and keep us in order, with laws like Jim Crow and the black codes to keep us low. On the cotton field there was always a white overseer to make sure we did the work, or you got your ass whooped. Today your taskmaster is your boss.

What was done to us in ancient Egypt is what was done to us in America. That is why this place is spiritually called Egypt.

precepts.text: Thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein. What house did we build here in America and could not dwell in? The White House. And in ancient Egypt we built treasure cities we did not dwell in.
precepts.point: All manner of service: we were their servants, cooking their food, watching their kids, entertaining them, singing for them. Sing us one of the songs of Zion. It is the same in America: the service jobs, the entertainment. We are kings and priests; we are not supposed to serve any nation. Our job is to serve God. But we have been slaves so long we got comfortable with the jobs they give us to do.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

precepts.why:
“And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.” We built cities in ancient Egypt, and it is the same thing here in America. Deuteronomy 28:30 lists it among the curses: “Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.”

In ancient Egypt we built cities and houses, and we did not build them for ourselves; we built them for the Egyptians. We were a commodity, and they did not look at us as human. America did the same.

What house did we build here in America and could not dwell in it? The White House. Construction began in 1792 in Washington D.C., and hundreds of enslaved people rented from plantation owners quarried the stone, cut the timber and laid the bricks, dawn to dusk, with no wages, whipped if they slowed down. Most are not even named in the records, just negro hired. When it was finished in 1800 and President Adams moved in, the enslaved workers were sent back to the plantations with no credit and no freedom, and for the next 65 years more enslaved people worked there. Some of you thought the white man built that.

We built cities in Egypt and did not dwell in them, and we built the White House and cannot dwell in it. The same curse, in ancient Egypt and in spiritual Egypt.

precepts.text: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field. The same way ancient Egypt made us slave in the fields with all manner of service, in America that curse also fell upon us in the fields.
precepts.point: All manner of service: we were their servants, cooking their food, watching their kids, entertaining them, singing for them. Sing us one of the songs of Zion. It is the same in America: the service jobs, the entertainment. We are kings and priests; we are not supposed to serve any nation. Our job is to serve God. But we have been slaves so long we got comfortable with the jobs they give us to do.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

precepts.why:
Exodus 1:14 says “they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field”. We were in the fields in ancient Egypt; we were not just building pyramids. They had us doing plantation work and cropping there too. Deuteronomy 28:16 is that curse: “Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.”

The same way ancient Egypt made us slaves and worked us in the fields with all manner of service, in America that curse also fell upon us. We were cursed in the cotton field, in the sugar cane field, in the tobacco field, with five year olds and two year olds picking cotton. Our lives were made bitter, and that is why we eat the bitter herbs at Passover: they represent our lives being bitter in Egypt.

And all manner of service: we were their servants, cooking their food, watching their kids, entertaining them. Sing, this Hebrew got a good voice, sing me one of the songs of Zion. That is what we do here in Babylon. Some of you drive a bus, fix the road, drive a taxi cab: servant jobs, and you don't see it. We have been slaves so long we got comfortable with the jobs they give us. We are kings and priests; we are not supposed to serve any nation. Our job is to serve God.

Read the curses of Deuteronomy 28 and then read what happened to us in ancient Egypt, and you will see they are the same. America is spiritual Egypt.

precepts.text: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body. The fruit of our body is our children. In ancient Egypt the midwives were commanded to kill the male babies; today the fruit of the body is cursed through abortion and through the systems set up against our sons.
precepts.point: How do they kill the fruit of the body today? Abortion. And how do they get rid of the males? The school to prison pipeline: they create conditions of poverty, bring drugs into the community, then put brothers away for the rest of their lives. That whole system was set up; that is them dealing wisely. The teaching also covered claims about vaccines being used against our children. They tried to destroy the poor secretly, because they are trying to stop the prophets from coming on the earth.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

precepts.why:
Pharaoh told the Hebrew midwives, “if it be a son, then ye shall kill him”. Where is that in Deuteronomy? “Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land”. What is the fruit of our body? Our children. That is why it says our children are going to be cursed.

In ancient Egypt, when the baby came out, Pharaoh commanded the midwives to kill it if it was a male. That is oppression. Today they do the same thing, and it is called abortion.

And how do they get rid of the males today? The school to prison pipeline. They create conditions for our people to live in poverty, bring drugs into the community, and when the brothers are out there selling, they put them away for the rest of their lives. That whole system was set up by Esau. That is them dealing wisely, “let us deal wisely with them.” And through the vaccines: when you look at the rate of autism in young black and Hispanic men, it is very high. They put things in the vaccines to mess with the babies' minds. But Esau has been mixing with us, so some of our DNA is in theirs, and now white people complain that their kids are coming out with autism too.

It goes back to the scripture that says they try to destroy the poor secretly. Secretly they try to kill every male child amongst us, because they are trying to stop the prophets from coming on the earth. What Pharaoh did in ancient Egypt, America is doing in spiritual Egypt.

precepts.text: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things. That curse was also on us in ancient Egypt: we had to serve the Egyptians for the want of all things, the same way you have to serve for it today.
precepts.point: Guess what: it is the same thing with us here in America. A lot of you have food, you are full, you are comfortable. Well, for now.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

precepts.why:
In the wilderness the children of Israel wept and said, “We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick”. What are they saying? Deuteronomy 28:48 explains it.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Serving our enemies in hunger and in thirst is one of the curses that was upon us, and it was also a curse that was on us in ancient Egypt. We had to serve the Egyptians for the want of all things. It is the same today: you need money to buy food, and you have to serve for it.

Back then we had fish, because the Nile was abundant in fish, and we had melons. So brothers got delivered from oppression and started talking about going back to Egypt: even though we were oppressed, at least there we had some good food. It is the same thing with us here in America. A lot of you have food, you are full, you are comfortable. Well, for now.

precepts.text: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things. Moses used the word enemies; John the revelator called him the serpent. They prophesied the same history: if you want food, water, clothing, education, or medicine, you have to go to your enemies, and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck.
precepts.point: To the woman were given two wings of a great eagle: the great escape. Where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent. We are nourished from America: everything we have, the foods we eat, the clothes we wear, the educations we have received have come from this white man, the dragon. John calls the enemy the serpent.

note.label: Religion - The False Prophet

precepts.why:
Revelation 12:14 says the woman is “nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.” We are nourished from America. Everything we have, every place we live, the foods we eat, the drinks we drink, the clothes we wear, the educations we have received, has come from this white man, the dragon. John calls him the serpent.

Deuteronomy 28:48 says the same thing, but Moses does not use the word serpent. Look at the word he uses: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee”. Moses used the word enemies. “in hunger”: you have to serve him for food. “and in thirst”: for water. “and in nakedness”: for clothing. “and in want of all things”: if you want anything, if you want education, if you want medicine, you have to go to your enemies.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” That is the history Moses prophesied, and the same history John the revelator prophesied. Moses called him the enemy, and John called him the serpent. The woman fed in the wilderness for a time, and times, and half a time, three and a half, is Israel living off the hand of the enemy that holds the yoke on her neck.

precepts.text: Thou shalt serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee in hunger, thirst, nakedness, and want of all things, with a yoke of iron on thy neck, until he have destroyed thee. The Lord sent Europe and America. For food, education, even to learn about God, we go to our enemies. The yoke came off, which proves we were destroyed, exactly as Daniel 8:24 says.
precepts.point: By peace shall destroy many, and he shall stand up against the Prince of princes and be broken without hand. That is Christ, and this is now.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.why:
Daniel says the king of fierce countenance “shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” Haven't we been destroyed? We have been destroyed as a people. Watch the wording of Deuteronomy 28:48.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee.” The Lord sent Europe against us; the Lord sent America against us. “in hunger”: for food. “and in thirst”: for water. “and in nakedness”: for clothing. “and in want of all things”: if you want anything, you have to go to your enemies. If you want education, go to your enemies. If you want to learn about God, you have to go to your enemies.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Here is the part we want: until he have destroyed us. The yokes of iron have been taken off. What does that prove? That we have been destroyed, exactly what Daniel 8:24 says.

And Daniel goes on: “by peace shall destroy many.” Donald Trump calls himself the president of peace and set up a board of peace, yet he has bombed Yemen, Somalia, Iraq, Iran, Syria, Nigeria and Venezuela. We are living in that time right now.

precepts.text: The Lord shall smite thee with madness, blindness, and astonishment of heart. Our people are mentally unstable and spiritually blind, always shocked at the world.
precepts.point: The fear of the Lord is all wisdom, Sirach 19:20, and in all wisdom is the performance of the law: be about it, not just talk about it. If you do not fear the Lord, that is where your problems are.

note.label: Hope Amid Destruction

precepts.why:
“And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times.” Why is that important? The wisdom and knowledge of this Bible keeps us mentally and spiritually stable. Deuteronomy 28:28 shows the opposite: “The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart.”

Madness: our people are crazy, mentally unstable, mentally insane. Blindness: we are spiritually blind. Astonishment of heart: our people are always shocked at what is going on in the world.

That is the curse that wisdom answers. Brothers, we all need the wisdom of God and the knowledge to keep us mentally and spiritually stable. The people who know the Bible are not shocked when these things happen, because the Bible already said it; the people without it are astonished at every turn.

precepts.text: Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen, and he shall call his servants by another name.
precepts.point: Israel became an astonishment, a proverb and a byword, called by names other than the one God gave. Israel means prince with God; there is no greater name.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 28:37 says Israel would become “an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations”: called by names outside of our God-given name. God gave us a name. Israel means prince of the power with God, and there is no mightier name on the face of the earth. Why would you want to call yourself a Latinized negro, a Latino? That is a racist term. You have to do the history and get the knowledge; you have to find yourself so you don't lose yourself.

Isaiah 65:15 says the same: “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen.” We left the name Israel for a curse, for racist terms like Latino, Hispanic, and names like Cuban, Colombian, Venezuelan, Dominican. Yet it is “unto my chosen”: we are God's chosen people. You have to see the greatness in who you are. We have fallen so far that we think we can't come out of it, but we are coming out, because there is a God.

“for the Lord God shall slay thee”. For wanting a king of another nation over us, for wanting to assimilate, the Most High slew us and caused the basest of men to rule over us. “and call his servants by another name”: now we are called Latino, blacks, spics, wetbacks, illegal aliens. That is why we do not know who we are, a confusion of faces. We are searching, but we are not searching the scriptures.

So-called Latinos, you are the Israelites. Latino is not your given name; your name is Israel, the twelve tribes of Israel. You think this is a black movement, a negro movement, but the twelve tribes of Israel are mainly so-called Latinos. We have to get back to our history and our true nationality.

precepts.text: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people.
precepts.point: We drink our water for money, our wood is sold to us, our necks are under persecution, and we labour and have no rest.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
“Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach”: see the curses that fell upon us for our sins. “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” The Chicago mayor was offended by the term alien, but the term is in the scriptures. The aliens are the strangers, the other nations. We are not the aliens; we are the natives of these lands. Esau has taken our lands, our resources, our inheritance.

“We are orphans and fatherless.” Why are we orphans? Deuteronomy 28:32: “Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people.” We see it all throughout history, and even now our northern kingdom children are separated from their parents. They killed our fathers, our leaders, the caciques and kings like Atahualpa, and burned them at the stake for not accepting the Christian religion. That is why the Asher in the Amazon grew up orphans and fatherless.

“and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long”. You will look to the white Jesus, but he can't save you. Donald Trump is not going to save you. The US government is not going to save you. No matter how much you perfect your English, the accent is going to slip out and they are going to catch you.

“and there shall be no might in thine hand” to save our children. We saw ICE agents, grown men with weapons and body armor, surrounding a five-year-old autistic girl and holding her hostage: a nation of fierce countenance. How much plainer can it be?

So-called Latinos, you have to see yourselves in the scriptures. You are no different from your black brothers, from Haitians, Jamaicans and African Americans; we are the same people, oppressed together. All these curses have to afflict you so that you can see this is your book, and what is happening to you for turning your back on the black Messiah, Jesus Christ. We have to return to our true nationality.

precepts.text: Thou shalt serve thine enemies in hunger, thirst and nakedness, and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck.
precepts.point: The merchandise of Babylon runs from gold and timber to slaves and souls of men. The countries of Israel are not underdeveloped but overexploited.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.why:
Babylon's merchandise runs from “gold, and silver, and precious stones” down to “slaves, and souls of men.” The tin, the copper, the iron, the rubber, the bauxite, the slaves and the cheap labor have all been taken out of our countries. These countries are not underdeveloped; they are overexploited. They all should be rich countries, world powers, with the blessings the Lord gave us in those places. It was done in Latin America and in Africa, especially the west coast where we are dispersed, and the slave routes and trade routes were the commerce they made of us.

The way they keep that dominance today is economic, backed by the threat of military power, and it follows a pattern, as with Noriega and now Maduro. First they criminalize the leader with drug, terror and corruption narratives, framing mischief by a law. Then they declare the regime illegitimate. Then they apply sanctions and economic siege. Then they isolate the country diplomatically and militarily, remove or extract the leadership, and install or manage a transition authority.

The sanctions are the modern face of Deuteronomy 28:48, for those who say the curses were only for back then or only for the time of the conquistadors: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. Want of all things because of sanctions and their economic might. If you try to nationalize your resources or do things outside of their money, even though you have your own resources you are overexploited to the point that you cannot do it on your own. There is no might in your hand.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” A lot of times we did this willingly. It is the same pattern we followed with Assyria and Egypt: when the United States became a world power we leaned on them, and found out really quick that they do not keep their word on anything. It is history repeating itself, the doctrine of the scripture executed over and over again.

precepts.text: All these curses shall come upon thee and overtake thee, because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord.
precepts.point: Ephraim is planted in a pleasant place but shall bring forth his children to the murderer. God gave the whitening a miscarrying womb and dry breasts, so much of what remains is still Israel.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.why:
Ephraim was “planted in a pleasant place”, the blessings, but “Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The murderer is Cain, Esau, Edom: the Spaniards, the United States. That was the whitening, el blanqueamiento, sometimes done willingly and sometimes not. So God said “give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of the babies of those who tried to whiten us out died, and what is left behind is largely not European; many who look European there came over later. Our job is to give the word, go to the chief places where our people resort as Christ taught, and let God do the separating.

How could a people fall so low, go through so much, and still rise and reconnect to their identity? People are baffled by it; to them it is ignorant and even offensive for us to know who we are. Deuteronomy 28:45 answers it: “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God.” And “they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.”

Those curses became our identity, and our redemption. They are the way we acknowledge who we are and make our way back. If not these curses, then who is it? The Bible always said Israel would come back to its identity, and now that we are back, the world is bugging out. Where are the lost tribes? They are here now.

It is God's grand plan. If we were all together in one spot, they could have wiped us out. By dispersing us into the four corners of the earth he also preserved us, like the worm in the movie Swordfish, broken up and scattered to the four corners of the internet so no one could get it back without the one who hid it. What was our curse, God meant for good, so that now we can come back together. As Hosea said, the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, and “in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

precepts.text: He shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck until he have destroyed thee.
precepts.point: God polluted Israel with man-made religions founded in America after slavery.

note.label: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity

precepts.why:
“I was wroth with my people”: wroth means angry. The pictures of our people in slavery, beaten, on the slave ships, lynched, murdered from the time of slavery all the way up to now, are God being wroth with his people. It is like a family album of our family. He allowed the white man to beat the hell out of us, and we were made slaves for the white man.

Deuteronomy 28:48 is what that anger looked like: “he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Think about the mindset of the brother in those conditions, with the big yoke of iron on his neck and in the different positions of slavery. Your mind is going to go crazy, because you know you are not supposed to be in that situation. That is what those torture devices were set to do.

“until he have destroyed thee” means until your mind breaks down, until your manhood is gone and your ability to be free is gone. When you just succumb to being a slave, your mental strength and fortitude to be independent is broken. That is what black people are today.

So Isaiah 47:6 says the same: “thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.” This Christian nation, as they say, showed us no mercy, and laid the yoke heavy even on the oldest among us. And she said “I shall be a lady for ever”, I will be Christian forever, and did not lay these things to heart, “neither didst remember the latter end of it”, though they have the Bible and know what it says will happen at the latter end.

precepts.text: If thou shalt hearken diligently, the Lord will set thee on high above all nations of the earth.
precepts.point: Israel is a holy people chosen above all people on the earth. If other nations can build wealth and houses together, so can Israel.

note.label: The Highway of the Upright: an Israelites's Strait Journey

precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 7:6 says the Lord chose Israel “to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.” Deuteronomy 28:1 says it as well, with the condition attached: “if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth.”

If God says we are above all people and above all nations, then why can we not do the things we have a concrete visual example of other nations doing, and doing for decades? When one of the Amish gets married, the community comes together and builds a house for that couple, and there is no mortgage attached to it. They do not even have power cars. We have enough knowledge, enough builders, plumbers and concrete men; we can do this too, at a higher level.

It is going to take work to build this kingdom: work, and faith that we can do the work, shown by our actions. We need to fix our credit scores, fix our health, learn group economics, and work together in the trades, so that when the tough times come, losing your job because of your last name or because you are tracked, we have things set up to help each other.

This is the highway of the upright, the Israelite's strait journey. Ezra saw that “A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things”, but “The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall”, with fire on the right hand and deep water on the left, and one path “so small that there could but one man go there at once.” That city is the kingdom of heaven, and we must pass through all these things in this captivity to inherit it.

At the end of it, “the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.” We were ransomed out to the nations, but we are returning and gathering together. Being set on high above all nations is the promise to the people who hearken and do the work.

precepts.text: The Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies.
precepts.point: Thou shalt serve other gods and serve thine enemies with a yoke of iron upon thy neck.

note.label: 2025 Recap: Different Times, Same Truth

precepts.why:
“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships.” Egypt means bondage, slavery. The children of Israel would go into bondage again, and this time by ships. That is the slave ships: the transatlantic slave trade, the Arab slave trade, the Indian Ocean slave trade, the triangle trade. We were taken on slave ships for 500 years and sold all over the world, and our identity, history, language, culture, diet and clothing were all taken from us. Every people had some form of slavery, but nobody else went through chattel slavery, where there is no end, no going seven years and out. Our whole nation was taken. The Irish did not have their history taken; the Germans did not have their history taken.

“and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen”: when we got off those slave ships we were sold to our enemies. The slave ships were tight pack and loose pack; the cargo at the bottom was our people. The immigrants came over with clothes on their backs and everything they wanted to bring from their land, established businesses, and are the ones who lend to us today, so they clearly are not the people.

“and no man shall buy you” means nobody is going to redeem you. It cannot mean offering yourself as a slave and nobody buying, because the same verse says you are going to be sold, and we know we were bought. Those who say the so-called white man is the real Jew cannot show the history of him offering himself as a slave with no one buying him. So their understanding is wrong, and those are not the people.

Read on to verse 64: “And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other.” We went from the west coast of Africa all over the world. “and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.” Our fathers never knew a white Jesus, and Jesus never looked like that picture hung in the house and in the church. Wood is symbolic for Christianity, the crucifix; stone for Islam, the cobblestone. Those are the two largest religions the children of Israel have been captured by in these last days, and the Arabs were some of the most brutal slave owners.

This is how Deuteronomy 28:15 is proven. The way you find out who you are is not ancestry.com or 23andMe. You line up the curses and ask: did my forefathers and foremothers go through these things? If they did, you are an Israelite. It is that simple, and nobody else can lay claim to it.

precepts.text: He shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck.
precepts.point: Thou shalt serve other gods and serve thine enemies with a yoke of iron upon thy neck.

note.label: 2025 Recap: Different Times, Same Truth

precepts.why:
“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee.” The Bible said we would serve our enemies, “in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things.” We had to go to our oppressors for everything. When we got off those slave ships we were butt naked, and there was no Dollar General in the slave quarters, and no money if there had been.

It is the same thing today. Stop working your job and watch what happens. You want your water turned on, your heat turned on, your car to go: you have to go to your oppressors. An education, a birth certificate, a death certificate, licensing, whatever it is: you have to go to your oppressor. That is “want of all things.”

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck”. Show the so-called Jewish man, the Ashkenazi, with a yoke of iron upon his neck. Type Jews with yokes of iron on neck into Google images and you cannot find them. What comes up is black people. Type in Jesus and you know what comes up, and they say Jesus was a Jew; so why aren't white people coming up with yokes of iron on them?

That is identifying us through the scriptures, not through DNA. The curses of Deuteronomy 28:15 came upon us and overtook us, and the yoke of iron is written on our people alone. Bringing that out is called racial idolatry now, but it is just showing people the truth.

precepts.text: He shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck.
precepts.point: Thou shalt serve other gods and serve thine enemies with a yoke of iron upon thy neck.

note.label: 2025 Recap: Different Times, Same Truth

precepts.why:
“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee.” The Bible said we would serve our enemies, “in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things.” We had to go to our oppressors for everything. When we got off those slave ships we were butt naked, and there was no Dollar General in the slave quarters, and no money if there had been.

It is the same thing today. Stop working your job and watch what happens. You want your water turned on, your heat turned on, your car to go: you have to go to your oppressors. An education, a birth certificate, a death certificate, licensing, whatever it is: you have to go to your oppressor. That is “want of all things.”

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck”. Show the so-called Jewish man, the Ashkenazi, with a yoke of iron upon his neck. Type Jews with yokes of iron on neck into Google images and you cannot find them. What comes up is black people. Type in Jesus and you know what comes up, and they say Jesus was a Jew; so why aren't white people coming up with yokes of iron on them?

That is identifying us through the scriptures, not through DNA. The curses of Deuteronomy 28:15 came upon us and overtook us, and the yoke of iron is written on our people alone. Bringing that out is called racial idolatry now, but it is just showing people the truth.

precepts.text: The fruit of thy land shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes.
precepts.point: Every age raised brethren who sought the welfare of their people and the sanctuary: Mordecai, Mattathias and his sons.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
Mattathias and his sons, Judas Maccabeus, Eleazar, Joannan, Jonathan and Simon, said “Let us restore the decayed fortune of our people, and let us fight for our people and the sanctuary.” They were willing to say “it is better for us to die in battle, than to behold the calamities of our people and our sanctuary.” Deuteronomy 28:33 shows what those calamities are, and why a brother who loves his people cannot sit still under them.

“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.” Being mad for the sight of thine eyes is racial anger. It is seeing yourselves oppressed and crushed always, whether in your own land or outside of it. The things you shall see will upset you: your people's condition, their mindsets today, how degenerate we have become over the course of a few generations. Israel is the worst now that it has ever been. We are on generation Z, the last letter of the alphabet; this generation is finished.

That is why it is important for us to be united on our own. Leave the Americanized, Romanized negroes to themselves, and those who repent as Israelites must come together and show forth a good example, so that those still in the American mindset may repent too and come into the flock. As long as they are out there, they are one of them: their opinion is Caucasian opinion, their mind is television, philosophy and social media, red pill or blue pill.

It is the same thing Solomon said: “Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.” A wise man knows when he is oppressed; a foolish man believes that even under oppression he is still free. And the gift, the record deal, the six-figure job, the holidays off, is what destroys the heart and takes away that racial anger.

So from Babylon to Persia to Greece to Rome, there was always an Israelite who would rise up for the welfare of his people, like Mordecai “seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed”, and like the Maccabees. When we do that we are called racist, a black radical hate group, while they are called white nationalists. They do not want to see us unite.

precepts.text: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people.
precepts.point: They that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them and send gifts one to another. Israel's people were the gifts.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.” Beside it stands verse 41: “Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” It is the same thing said twice: our children given into the hands of other people.

That is Revelation 11:10: “they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another”. Who were the gifts? We were the gifts, passed from one to another, from one generation of slaveholders to the next, like the negro girl about five years old deeded to him and his heirs forever. Merry Christmas. The two prophets are Judah and Ephraim; “these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth” when we were ruling, and when we were given into their hands it was payback.

The paintings from Britain, Italy, France and all over Europe show it: black children stripped from their parents, holding umbrellas, mirrors, birds and music for their masters, serving at the table, a grown sister in Nantes with the iron collar still on her neck. The same in Japan and China, where the Arabs brought us dressed the same way to hold the umbrella. They called us their negro favorites, as with the princesses of France, as Charlize Theron and Madonna have their adopted favorites today. Lucrezia Borgia, sister of Cesare Borgia and daughter of Pope Alexander VI, posed with her black slave boy as Mary with the child. They had black favorites in Russia too, where we once ruled.

The Jewish histories tell the same. Under the Inquisition, when families were taken, the children became wards of the holy office, given to foster parents to indoctrinate them with Catholic dogma and teach them to abhor anything Jewish, to despise all Jews, and to say the Jews killed our Lord and were cursed to perpetual wandering: the same doctrine Christians use on us today. When Jews were driven from Spain and could not pay to leave Portugal within the eight months, they were sold as slaves. King John had all Jewish children under fourteen torn from their parents' arms, dragged into the church and baptized; those under three given to Christians for a Christian education, in other words to be raised as slaves; those from three to ten shipped to St. Thomas, an island run by condemned criminals; those from ten to fourteen sold. The bereaved parents fell prostrate at the king's feet as he left church on a Sunday, begging, and he had them dragged from his path and mocked them as dogs whose whelps were torn from them.

That is thine eyes failing with longing for them all the day long, with no might in thine hand. A Christian education is a doctrine of slavery: Baptist, Pentecostal, Methodist, Seventh-day Adventist, Jehovah's Witness, you are raised as a slave.

precepts.text: They that carried us away captive required of us a song.
precepts.point: Old maps and accounts name Whydah 'Judah' and the Loango coast 'the Jews' Bay,' and describe twelve tribes with circumcision and Sabbath customs in Guinea.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
“For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.” “How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a strange land?” We read it right there in the history of the slave ships.

Deuteronomy 28:68 says “the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. What does Egypt represent? “I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.” Egypt is bondage. The Lord would bring us into bondage again, this time by way of ships; literal Egypt we would see no more again as a nation, and there we would be sold to our enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, slave men and slave women.

The Middle Passage, the Maafa, a massive disaster: for fifty days or more our people were packed in spaces as tight as coffins, a second platform barely twenty inches above the heads of those below, chained to the floor, lying in their own waste, amid rats that gnawed through wood and flesh, on floors covered with blood and excrement, where pregnant women gave birth and the living awoke chained to the dead. Tight packers crammed in as many as possible, reckoning the sales would offset the dead. The meal was horse beans pounded to a pulp with slabber sauce, once or twice a day, and a pint of water. Dumb negroes say it never happened and ask where the ships are: cargo ships carried spices and corn before us, carried us as cargo, and after slavery carried cargo again. Why get rid of them?

Then came the dancing of the slaves: the crew played the bagpipe or forced our ancestors to beat out a rhythm while they jumped about, ankles rubbed raw by the leg irons, to keep the human cargo in salable condition. That is Psalms 137:3: those who carried us away captive required of us mirth. At night the cries rose; an enslaved woman explained the howling came from having dreamt they were in their own country and waking in the hold of a slave ship. A strange land indeed.

Millions were carried from Africa to the West Indies, North and South America and Europe, from Luanda, from the Congo, from Loango, where the old maps mark the Jews; the buyers and sellers both knew they were selling outsiders, not the same people. Deuteronomy 28:68 and Psalms 137:3 were fulfilled on those ships.

precepts.text: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
precepts.point: Thou shalt grope at noonday and not prosper in thy ways.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
“They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.” They raped our women; they raped the Judahite sisters. This is not new. Whatever color the oppressor was, the nations all had the same habits, because judgment is like a ring: it recurs over and over again. Same game, different characters.

It is the curse of Deuteronomy 28:30: “Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her”. In The Butler, the master takes the boy's mother from the cotton field; she cannot say no; she screams, and the father and everyone in the field stand there powerless, unable to do a thing. In The Birth of a Nation, a guest demands Hark's new wife Esther for the night, and the master allows it; she comes out in tears, and he cries, Where is God now? That racial anger is what drove Nat Turner to take the axe to the master. We were powerless to protect our wives and our children. And “thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein”: we built the house and never dwelt in it.

That trauma is the madness of verse 28: “The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart”. Coming off those ships we were smitten with madness. In 12 Years a Slave, Patsey, beaten until her back was ripped open for a piece of soap because she could not stand her own smell, begs Solomon Northup to hold her under the water until she is without life, and to bury her in a lonely place; she has no comfort in this life. You cannot expect reparations to fix that. Blindness is spiritual: some watching right now say Jesus and the Jews are white; they are gone. “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways”, as a nation.

You millennials grew up thinking the white man is peaceful and loving and your friend. Malcolm X, Martin Luther King and our people of the 50s, 60s and 70s knew who the enemy was; after that we forgot and started saying the enemy is only a spiritual demon. They gave us Section 8, food stamps and Christianity, and we went back to sleep. So God is letting Trump and the administration behind him do evil, reverting the white man to his true nature, and JD Vance says they will no longer apologize for being white, so that we develop that racial anger again. That is why they want to remove this history from the museums and the schools. Let your children watch Roots, 12 Years a Slave, The Birth of a Nation, Amistad; the Holy Ghost brings all things to remembrance, and the scripture says what they did to our women in Zion.

precepts.text: Princes are hanged up by their hand.
precepts.point: Princes are hanged up by their hand. Lynching was the fulfilment; they even hung infants about their mothers' necks under Antiochus.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
“Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.” Princes hanged up means lynched. Young or old, it did not matter; you were hanged all the same.

That is what “thy life shall hang in doubt before thee” comes to. Hanging in doubt does mean you will wonder whether you live or die, worried day and night, in the hood, the ghetto and the slums, and further back in slavery and colonization: “In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning!” But it also means hanging. Lamentations 5 is the whole picture of the curse: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens”, the European, the East Indian and the Chinese man in Africa and Trinidad reaping our resources; “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us”, which is colonization; “Servants have ruled over us”, those who were once our slaves.

The Spaniards hanged the Americans thirteen at a time and set them on fire. Without Sanctuary, a book of lynching photographs, shows it: 1935, which was yesterday; postcards of our fore mothers and fathers hanging from trees; a man burned to pieces, his hands and legs cut off and kept as souvenirs; a mother and son hanged from a bridge in 1901. White people today say, I didn't do that, that was my ancestors. But look at the postcards: children, fathers, mothers, women right in the middle, the whole family supporting it, children who grew up to be your lawyers, teachers, mayors and police officers.

Mary Turner, in 1918, grieving her husband Hayes Turner, lynched without a trial, threatened to have his killers punished. The next day she was hanged from a tree, burned, her womb cut open; the baby, a month shy of being born, cried on the ground, and a member of the white mob crushed its head with his foot; then they shot her full of holes. Now they say they are not apologizing anymore. In Queens in 1976 white children chased little black girls out of their neighborhood with rocks and dogs, calling them niggers, and those children are judges, lawyers and police officers now. This is war.

Hanging is nothing new; the Persians did it (1 Esdras 6:32), “out of his own house should a tree be taken, and he thereon be hanged”. Christ himself was lynched: “whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.” Peter called the cross a tree, wood, where he hung for hours. “Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree”: Christ went under the curse along with us. The King and his children were hanged. Princes are hanged up by their hand.

precepts.text: Two women who circumcised their children were led about with the babes hanging at their breasts.
precepts.point: Princes are hanged up by their hand. Lynching was the fulfilment; they even hung infants about their mothers' necks under Antiochus.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
The Greeks did it too. Under Antiochus, 1 Maccabees 1:60-61: “they put to death certain women, that had caused their children to be circumcised.” “And they hanged the infants about their necks, and rifled their houses, and slew them that had circumcised them.” After they killed the mothers, they hung the circumcised babies from their dead mothers' necks and put them on display for the people to see. They lynched our babies on their mothers' necks. It is the same persecution recorded of the mothers who circumcised their children and were led about the city with the babes at their breasts.

Esau was so demonic and wicked that he ran around checking who was circumcised, running through our houses and killing anyone who circumcised a child. Who does that? Demons.

That is Deuteronomy 28:66: “thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life”. Keeping the law of God, circumcising your child as the covenant commands, could cost a mother her life and her baby's. It is the same spirit that hanged our princes, burned our mothers and crushed our babies here in America. Same game, different characters: judgment is like a ring, recurring over and over.

Peter and the apostles answered, “We ought to obey God rather than men”, and the mothers of the Maccabees did so to the death. Christ was hanged on a tree too; the King and his children have all hung under the same curse, until the Lord says enough.

precepts.text: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad.
precepts.point: Thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see. Racial anger at oppression is in the scriptures; those who feel nothing have shut down.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
Oppression makes a wise man mad. That is racial anger, and it is in the scriptures. Deuteronomy 28:33 gives the oppression: “The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”. That is what was told of the man brought to this side of the world. Then verse 34: “So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.”

You are going to be mad. Your eyes are going to be mad for what you see: the oppression, all the evil taking place against your people. You see your wife being raped and you cannot do anything. You see your people being lynched and you cannot do anything. You are just angry. The curse prophesied that anger.

So if you see your people oppressed and going through these things, and you are not mad, not angry, something is not right. You have shut down. There must be racial anger. Being mad at the sight of the oppression of our people is not a sin to be ashamed of; it is what the scripture said the oppression would do to us, and it is the wise response to what our eyes have seen.

precepts.text: They shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
precepts.point: These curses shall be upon thee for a sign and a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever, until the Lord says enough.

note.label: False New Year: True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” Our children were snatched up, taken from us, and sold off to the highest bidder. Then verse 45: “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed”. Why pursue? Because we tried to run from the curses: to Spain, to Italy, to Britain. Wherever we ran, the same curses followed: slavery, colonization, children sold off, enslaved and killed. They followed us and overtook us, down to the lowest state.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” These are generational curses. For you stupid, asinine apologetics asking what curses: these are not one-time curses, you imbeciles, you big dummy. They are constant. Upon thy seed means they repeat: when you are dead and gone, the same curse that fell upon you falls on your kids and your kids' kids. For ever means until the Lord says enough. To us it is 500 years; to the Lord it is a few seconds.

The record shows the sign on our seed. The ship captains carried a route map to the slave coast and insurance papers, so if we died or were thrown overboard as cargo, the owner was reimbursed; we were property. The owners told the captains which African ethnic group was preferred; they knew exactly whom they were taking, with the help of the Arabs and the Hamites. It was war, as Revelation 13 says he made war with the saints and overcame them, and we lost the war and became the slaves; if they had left us there, we would still be teaching that we are the children of Israel.

Children as young as two and three worked up to twenty hours a day; at the African Burial Ground in New York there are skeletons of three-year-olds with bones worn down to nothing. Solomon Northup told how the hands worked from light until too dark to see, and under the full moon until the middle of the night, with ten or fifteen minutes to swallow cold bacon. A slaveholder gave Christmas off so we would reverence it. The black child learned early that the world favored white and despised black, and the black mother learned that black men were powerless to protect her, which still affects our women today in the feminist mentality: we were both powerless.

The cry of a black mother as another child was separated from her and sold is Deuteronomy 28:41 before your eyes, as in the auction of Eliza, whose boy was sold away and whose little girl was kept back. That curse was upon us for a sign and a wonder, and it is still upon our seed until the Lord says enough.
