Judah is whom thy brethren shall praise. The so-called freedom we have here came through African-Americans like Martin Luther King, Malcolm X, the Black Panthers, Fred Hampton, and Huey P. Newton. Those men sacrificed themselves. Haitians, Benjamin, and the northern kingdom come here and run their mouths against Judah, but Judah sacrificed so you could come here. Now people from Sudan say they're not black, they're Arab. Levi and Benjamin have been doing this for years too. Judah is the gateway that opened the door. You say Judah accomplished nothing in hundreds of years while you've got so much in fifty years? Judah died for this. How many of you died for this? What the hell are you talking about? The so-called African-American died so you can run your big mouth.

The white man doesn't say his hatred is only for African-Americans and not Haitians. He comes after everybody. 'I'm not African-American. I'm Haitian.' … don't give a damn. 'I'm not black. I'm Sudanese.' You're an idiot if you think he puts you in a different box. He puts all of us in one box. The house of David is the whole twelve tribes. David ruled forty years, then Solomon. After Solomon we weren't together again. The Most High is bringing everybody together under Christ.

note.label: Spiritual Uprising: When God Shakes a Nation

precepts.why:
“To set up on high those that be low”. That's us. God will take the lowest in society and raise them high, and nobody will see it coming. “that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.” Those mourning will be exalted. Nobody can get lower than the black man. We're the most hated people on the planet.

Everything is blamed on the black man. Esau kills each other, and that's the black man's fault. We can't get any lower. What have we got to lose? Look at our condition. This is what sin caused.

note.label: The Gospel Is Black Liberation

precepts.why:
“But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:”

Jump to verse 32: “Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.” That slavery is a result of breaking God's commandments. Breaking God's commandments is sin.

Verse 41: “Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them;” Why? “for they shall go into captivity.” See that? That's the result of sinning. That's the result of breaking God's commandments. So whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin, and the servant of sin ends up in captivity: the spiritual and the literal are the same thing.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

precepts.why:
“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” That's what we do in the streets, teaching against what America taught us and warning of this place's destruction. Christians aren't on the corners saying it will end. They call that radical behavior now, but it's what the prophets always did.

America, the Crusades, coming here to enslave, murder, rape, and rob a country—that's radical behavior. When it's our turn to establish our kingdom, it's a problem. I'm not talking about raping or doing that. There's no revolution without bloodshed; we just have to wait on Christ. Lord, burn this thing up. Bring it down. If that's what it's called, sign me up.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” The stranger rises above you and you fall low. “He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him”. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”. Our enemies lend to us. In the hood: pawn shops, payday loans, SNAP, EBT. We're in financial ruins, seduced by rap videos and keeping up with the Joneses, buying all kinds of things without knowing God's laws. We're our worst enemies. Train the child to know the borrower, the lender, and his enemy.

Payday loans trap you in interest. Borrow $300 and pay $1,200 or $1,300; you'll be paying interest for the next thirty years. That's extortion, usury, oppression.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

precepts.why: “The Lord shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do”. God vexes everything we put our hands to, reminding us we sinned against him; in it we realize our enemy. You can't understand who you are without understanding who your enemy is. Parents and leaders do children a disservice by not equipping them. We're not telling you to harm anyone, but know who they are. How many times do they have to lynch your black behind before you understand they don't care? Churches fool people with slavery was good, you didn't protest, good white people took you—stop. Our young ones know the precepts and aren't fools behind that.

We identify who the Israelites are through these curses; that is our genetic marker. And a wonder: for us to wonder why these things keep happening to us. And upon thy seed for ever.

The Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships. Egypt here means the house of oppression, the house of bondage. Definition read in class: Egypt, from the Hebrew Mizraim, means shut in, restraint, misery, tribulation, distress. This time on ships: cargo slave ships. The biggest one we know is the transatlantic slave trade of the 1600s, though it happened many times in history.
By the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: Moses is making it plain that he is not talking about ancient Egypt.
There ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you. Buy means redeem: no man shall redeem us. The only one that came that could redeem us is Christ.

note.label: Seeking Justice in an Unjust System

points: Thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness. At noonday the sun is high; you are supposed to see clearly. But our people are blind, groping into Christianity, into Islam, not even knowing who we are as a nation. We are asleep.

And thou shalt not prosper in thy ways. This does not mean we cannot prosper because of anything lacking in us. It means when we try and we do prosper, our enemies come and destroy it. Tulsa, Black Wall Street: we were prospering, and they came and bombed us and destroyed it. We had our own banks and they took that. The same system keeps our people impoverished in Africa: the IMF, destabilization, terrorists suddenly appearing all over the continent. Our enemies create conditions to keep us beneath them.

And thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore. There will always be injustice against us; we will never get justice until our King returns. For decades our people kept marching, "I am a man," "no justice, no peace," and the oppression never stopped. They use one thing to replace the next: after slavery came Jim Crow and the black codes; during civil rights came redlining and dividing the houses, getting the father out of the home; then crack was brought into the community; then the war on drugs. The oppression is always there. That rap music they push is oppression too: celebrities are paid to keep us in the midst of sin to keep their prisons full.

note.label: Seeking Justice in an Unjust System

points: Among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: everywhere we go, we are not quite home. We are always being pushed on: move on, get from here, get from there. We have never experienced being home at all. The only time I got some experience of that is when I came to this truth and the brothers told me, welcome home. That felt like home, because I knew I was in the right ship that is going to take us all home.

The Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind. Sorrow of mind is experiencing a terrible situation you cannot do anything to change, and you just have to experience the sorrow in it.

In thirst: they could cut off or contaminate our water supply at any time, like they did in Flint, Michigan. The Messiah is the savior of the Israelites; that's why they changed him from a black man to a white man, so they could execute their plan.

points: The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, as swift as the eagle flieth: what's the symbol of the United States of America? The eagle, on the dollar bill, on the quarter, on their military. When they landed on the moon they said, the eagle has landed.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: A nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand: that's why they forced us to speak English. The New Testament is written in Greek because the Caucasians that enslaved us first under Alexander the Greek forced us to speak Greek, 300 years before Christ came. That's why Paul says there's no difference between the Jew and the Greek: he's talking to us. A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young: they don't care if you're young or old, they want to control your soul.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: This is what the churches stay confused on. The Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, even wood and stone. We would worship wood, the wooden cross, and the stone of the Kaaba. This scattering was the result of breaking God's commandments.

But we got to learn to bring it out on a broad experience, because the curses follow us wherever we are: the brothers on this side of the world, on that side of the world, on any side of the world.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: The curses shall be upon thee for a sign, and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever. Why a sign? Like a McDonald's sign lets you know a McDonald's is there. Because according to prophecy we would be scattered in slavery and forget our nationality, God said: these curses are going to follow you and your seed, so no matter where you are scattered, when you read the Bible you're going to say, wait, this is talking about my people. In the future, Judah will need to identify who Israel is; today you identify the Israelites by the curses.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high, and thou shalt come down very low: that's how it is in society today. There's no such thing as equality; don't let nobody fool you with that democracy and equal rights talk. Somebody has to be on top and somebody has to be on the bottom. We have been assimilated into their society, and they are on top. No matter if one, two, three Negroes become millionaires or billionaires, you cannot rise above your people while our people are the base of society.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: you need a loan, you go to the white man's bank. Now take it on an international, geopolitical level: does Africa borrow from China? Does Jamaica borrow from China? China lends to the Caribbean and Africa, and when our people cannot pay, China takes their land and resources. Russia lends to African nations. And the IMF tells Africa what their money is worth and gives loans they cannot pay back. That's the curse in action: it's talking about Africa, Guatemala, Panama, Ecuador, Venezuela, Chile, wherever our people are scattered and wherever our people are governing.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: He shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail. Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee: no matter where we are, the curses pursue us. The reason Africa is at the bottom of the food chain among all nations, while the Arabs and the Chinese are rich, is because most of the people over there are our people.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies: whether it's the white man, the Chinese, the Russians, or the Arabs. In hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: food, clothing, water, education; anything you need, you got to serve your enemy for it. The educational systems in Africa and the Caribbean were designed by the colonizers.

Video played in class: Thomas Sankara explaining why he refused food aid: it keeps us in a beggar mentality, and it stops our farmers from producing; those who really want to help can send plows, tractors, and boreholes, not bags of wheat. They killed him; his best friend was paid to do it. Africa and the Caribbean depend on America for food because that's the deal the IMF makes: we'll lend you billions, but you can't grow your own food; you buy it from our farmers. That's control: disagree, and they shut off your food supply.

And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee: they didn't just take millions of us to the Western Hemisphere; they went into Africa and enslaved the ones that remained. Colonization is slavery. Don't get confused by the terminology. When King Leopold colonized the Congo, he enslaved us.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people: when King Leopold came, record read in class of the forced rubber quotas in the Congo and the mutilation of those who fell short; the curses followed our sons and daughters into colonization, and there was no might in thine hand to get them back.

The same sons and daughters left in Africa were colonized, taught Christianity, enslaved. Why do you think everybody in Africa worships white Jesus? You think one day they got up and chose that? The same thing they did to us on this side of the world in slavery, they did to our people in Africa. They always want to say black people sold black people into slavery: don't let them fool you. Slavery was big business; the white man caused division amongst the tribes, armed them against each other, and took the prisoners of war. And who colonized Africa?

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known. The king whom the Lord chose was David and David's seed; after Babylon, no king from David's lineage was ever raised up again. So when did we set kings over us? In Africa, and on this side of the world: the chiefs of North America, the kings of Puerto Rico and Guatemala, the kings of Africa. Image shown in class: the king Atahualpa, whom the colonizers killed while forcing Christianity, one of the bloodiest religions, on our people.
And there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone: that's where Christianity and Islam come in; the Lord saw us following the religions forced on us.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: Thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: when the white man came and conquered, the Bible said it's not going to be restored. The white man ain't restoring nothing to us.

Article read in class: the major European powers compensated the slave owners, not the enslaved. The UK paid 20 million pounds, roughly 26 billion dollars today, to 46,000 owners in 1833; France compensated owners in 1849, concentrated among the top ten percent. When Haiti won independence, Haiti had to pay reparations to France, billions, and only finished paying in living memory. And in America, the compensation act gave $300 per slave to slave owners. The people that were enslaved can't get reparations, but the slave master got compensated for his merchandise. That's the world we're living in.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: The Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships. This Egypt is talking about the transatlantic slave trade, us being brought into the Americas. This is the last curse that fell upon the Israelites: they would go into slavery into another Egypt, another house of bondage, but this time on ships. It happened in the 1600s; we were brought here on cargo slave ships.
By the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: meaning it is not ancient Egypt.

And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you: nobody would be able to redeem you out of that house of bondage. Only Christ could redeem us from this place, because the scripture says Christ bought us with a price.

note.label: The Plagues Coming to America

points: The Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships: cargo slave ships. We went into slavery again with ships because we broke God's commandments, and God put Esau over us; it is part of Esau's blessing and our curse.

There ye shall be sold unto your enemies: not only to the white man but to other nations, through the transatlantic slave trade, the trans-Saharan slave trade, and along the Silk Road, all the way to China, Japan, and the Philippine islands; parts of Issachar are in the Philippines, and the tribe of Ephraim is in Hawaii.
And no man shall buy you: no revolutionary will save us, no matter how eloquently they speak or how hard they fight.

Trip report from Puerto Rico: the brothers visited Heriberto Marin Torres, the last survivor of the Puerto Rican Nationalist Party, 97 years old and strong, labeled a terrorist and a communist when all he loved was his people. He knew Pedro Albizu Campos personally, and his memoir covers the Ponce and Utuado massacres. They are going to say the same things about us.

At the library that week the brothers went through the original identification documents of the slaves held on the island. Books found in Puerto Rico were shown: Puerto Rico Negro, Fotografias para la Historia de Puerto Rico, a study of the decline of the slave trade in Puerto Rico from 1820 to 1860, and Sugar, Slavery, and Freedom in Nineteenth Century Puerto Rico. Yes, Puerto Ricans are black.
Film referenced: El Resplandor, a short Puerto Rican film on slavery on the island; slow paced, but it gets the message sent.

Posters shown from the Wayland Rudd Collection, Soviet era artwork about our people: he carried Africa in his heart, Lumumba; the end of colonialism; no to colonialism; colonialism is doomed; we mourn for Lumumba, Africa must live; colonizers must answer, that is where caught red-handed comes from; freedom to all the peoples of Africa, meaning freedom to all the peoples of the Israelites; a soldier receiving a medal from the ghost of the Third Reich for services in Vietnam; and I used to hold the whip in my hands, on how they colonize minds and make us taskmasters over our own, no different than in the days of Moses. points: But if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes, all these curses shall come upon thee and overtake thee. Now we do some precepting, word by word.
The voice of the Lord is his commandments; to hearken unto his voice means to keep his commandments.

Observe to DO all his commandments: do is the action word. The Most High is a God of doing, and by him actions are weighed. Do not talk proudly and arrogantly, saying God loves me no matter what and God knows my heart; he had a personal relationship with a few men like Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Samuel, and David, and talking like you are one of them is arrogancy coming out of your mouth.

Curses means evil: the Lord said, I will bring evil upon this people because they have not hearkened unto my words. Overtake thee means you shall not be able to escape them, and though they cry unto him, he will not hearken.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Cursed shalt thou be in the city: as when police fired on a car of siblings as young as nine years old in Georgia after the children panicked when a cruiser followed their vehicle. That is cursed in the city.
Cursed shalt thou be in the field: we came off the slave ship and went right to the field, picking cotton from sunup to sundown. We know that one.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store: that goes into your businesses and your holdings. It is hard enough for a black man or woman to start a business; we are left with side hustles while the major trades, the ships, the metals, and the timber belong to Esau.
These curses are on us as a nation. It is not about us individually; keep that in mind.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body: your children. The same children panicking in front of police, and the dozens of children killed by youth gun violence in Chicago in a matter of months.

Cursed shall be the fruit of thy land, thy kine, and thy sheep: the food we eat is cursed. Fast food fills our neighborhoods, and where there is no fast food there is a corner store selling unclean meat that causes diseases in us.

Ezekiel says it plainly: the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles. Others may eat that food, but it is foul for us because we are supposed to eat the best food on the planet, for we are an holy people as Deuteronomy 14 says.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in and cursed when thou goest out. He is talking about Jerusalem, but it is twofold: it is coming in and going out of life itself.
Ecclesiasticus, for you newer people in the Apocrypha, spells it out: we are born under the curses and we die still living under them.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The Lord shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke in all that thou settest thine hand unto, until thou be destroyed.
Rebuke means sharp disapproval or criticism because of your behavior: no matter what you do, nobody will see the silver lining in it; even what you mean for good turns out bad.

Vexation means the state of being annoyed or a thing that causes annoyance: among these nations they do not love you, they tolerate you. Your marching for equal rights annoys them; they ask why you will not just accept what you were given.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The Lord shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee: diseases. He shall smite thee with a consumption, a fever, an inflammation, an extreme burning, the sword, blasting, and mildew.
Amos shows what the blasting and mildew go into: famine, pestilence after the manner of Egypt, young men slain with the sword, death and destruction.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thy heaven over thy head shall be brass, and the earth under thee iron. It is twofold: rain not coming down and crops not coming up.
It also goes into the chains above your head and the shackles of iron on your feet. Look up the images of slavery and you see whose neck the chains were on.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The rain of thy land shall be powder and dust from heaven until thou be destroyed.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thou shalt go out one way against thine enemies and flee seven ways before them, and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth: 1492 and 1619.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thy carcase shall be meat unto the fowls of the air and the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away. Look up Wounded Knee, where the United States cavalry killed the Native Americans, who are Gad in the Bible, and left their bodies in the snow.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The Lord will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, the emerods, the scab, and the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
The itch that cannot be healed: look up who has the highest rates of sexually transmitted diseases right now. It is us.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The Lord shall smite thee with madness, blindness, and astonishment of heart, and thou shalt grope at noonday as the blind gropeth in darkness.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thou shalt not prosper in thy ways, and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee: going back into bondage.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thou shalt betroth a wife and another man shall lie with her: our wives were taken away, raped, robbed, and murdered in the captivity.
Thou shalt build an house and not dwell therein: we built the master's house, we built the White House, and to this day our people frame the roofs of suburban houses they will never live in.

Thou shalt plant a vineyard and not gather the grapes: down south our people and the Haitians, who are Levi, are still in the fields picking beans and oranges, and none of it comes back to them; it is packaged and shipped somewhere else.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face and shall not be restored to thee: no reparations. They just pulled the okey-doke in North Carolina, promising reparations and then saying it would not be paid in money but in infrastructure. The Most High said it would not be restored.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look and fail with longing for them all the day long, and there shall be no might in thine hand.

The slave narratives collected in When I Was a Slave back it up: slaves were treated like cattle, a speculator went about the country buying them up, and it was pitiful to see children taken from the mother's breast, mothers sold from children, husbands sold from wives.

Another narrative: slavery days were hell; babies were snatched from their mother's breast and sold to speculators, children separated from sisters and brothers and never saw each other again. The Bible is a true book, and our ancestors backed it up.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The fruit of thy land and all thy labours shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up, and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway.
The record of the conquistadors says one Spaniard ate enough for seven of the Indians, the northern kingdom. They literally ate up the fruit of the land.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The Lord shall bring thee and thy king unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all nations: Puerto Rican, Dominican, Haitian, Jamaican, African American, gentile. We lost our name and left it for a curse, like it says in Isaiah, while others wear the name and cry anti-Semitic.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field and gather but little in; thou shalt plant vineyards but neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes; olive trees through all thy coasts, but no oil to anoint thyself.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them, for they shall go into captivity: the same story the slave narratives tell.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: All thy trees and the fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high, and thou shalt come down very low; he shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him; he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail. Basically, you will always be oppressed.

Their own book, New World Jewry, says the Jewish converts were so disseminated through all the trading parts of the world that they became the pegs and nails that keep the whole frame of commerce together, back in the 1600s. But the curse says Israel comes down very low and borrows from the stranger. The lender at the top of world trade and the cursed borrower cannot be the same people; somebody is lying, and now we caught it.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: All these curses shall pursue thee and overtake thee till thou be destroyed, because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: They shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever. There is no time limit on this thing; that is how we know we are the real Israelites, because these curses are still hitting us all over the earth in some shape, form, or fashion to this day.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart for the abundance of all things: we have to be happy keeping these commandments.
That means joyful at the new moon, joyful on the sabbath, joyful in the classes. The lack of joy in keeping the commandments is the very reason the captivity came.

Sisters, that includes the commandment to be obedient and in subjection to your husband. Do not act like it is bondage; your husband cannot save you on the day of judgment, and you must work out your own salvation and stand before Christ with a joyful spirit in the commandments.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in want of all things, and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck until he have destroyed thee.

Here is one way we stay destroyed: Juneteenth. The slave narrative records the master telling his slaves, this is military law, but I am forced to tell you this law says you are now free; I cannot make you stay unless you want to. That June 19th announcement of the master's law is what is still celebrated in Texas.
Our people celebrate Juneteenth like it is something to be proud of, but it is the slave master's holiday, and we are still slaves under the curses.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth: the eagle is the symbol of Esau's nation.
A nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand: we did not speak English, and our brothers in the islands and South America did not speak Spanish when the ships came.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old nor shew favour to the young: they worked the old to death in the cotton fields, and today an old man dies with a knee held on his neck for over eight minutes, and children get fired on by police. Neither old nor young is spared.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: He shall eat the fruit of thy cattle and the fruit of thy land until thou be destroyed, leaving thee neither corn, wine, nor oil.

The Native Americans lived off the land, following the buffalo and the deer and making coats of skins. Now Reuben stays by the casino and Gad lives on reservation lands like barren wasteland where nothing grows, with outdoor plumbing, and it has never been restored. Reparations is not a casino, and it is not being called sovereign while occupied by another nation.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: He shall besiege thee in all thy gates until thy high and fenced walls come down. Verse 52 onward is going into the siege of Jerusalem by Babylon and by Rome, and Assyria did this also. This is NOT talking about black-on-black violence; do not use it for that.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and daughters, in the siege and in the straitness wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee. The Most High starved our people out in the siege until they boiled and ate their own children.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The proof it is not street violence is in the text itself: the tender man's eye shall be evil toward the wife of his bosom and toward the remnant of his children, because he has nothing left in the siege. It describes a good, caring, delicate man broken by famine, not violence in the neighborhood.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The tender and delicate woman, which would not set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness: our sisters have fallen a long way from that standard of tenderness and delicateness, and they need to return to it.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD, then he will make thy plagues wonderful, plagues of thy seed, of long continuance, and sore sicknesses.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Verse 59 is saying the Most High will make up diseases to keep punishing you; he will even have Esau create them in a laboratory and make them affect you more than anybody else.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: He will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt which thou wast afraid of, and also every sickness and every plague which is NOT written in the book of this law, until thou be destroyed.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude, because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the Lord thy God.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: As the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good and to multiply you, so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you. We have to understand who we are dealing with: he is happy to bless you and happy to destroy you for breaking the commandments.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: The Lord shall scatter thee among all people from the one end of the earth even unto the other, and there thou shalt serve other gods which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone: that is talking about Christianity and Islam.

The Handbook of Denominations records that as early as 1700 white slaveholders in the south provided religious teaching for their slaves, and the slaves identified with the faith of their owners: if your slave master was Baptist you were Baptist; if he was Catholic you were Catholic.
The same book says black Baptist doctrine runs quite parallel to that of white Baptist churches: it is the same exact thing, the slave master's religion with a black face on it.

The Most High is saying: wherever I scatter you, you will not know me; you will be caught up thinking you serve me, but you do not know me. The only time you will know him is when he puts his spirit back on the earth and reveals it in the last days. That is why there is so much turmoil in our life, because we were not serving God right.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest, but the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind.

No ease: the northern kingdom is catching it right now, with migrant children taken from their families and detained in hotels not even registered with the government before deportation, and thousands of those children cannot be found.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Thy life shall hang in doubt before thee, and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life. That is why those children panicked when the police car pulled up behind them: no assurance of thy life.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even, and at even, Would God it were morning, for the fear of thine heart and the sight of thine eyes.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: Here is the nail in the coffin: the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships. Egypt means bondage; the scripture defines it right in Deuteronomy 5, the land of Egypt, the house of bondage. He is saying: I will bring you into slavery again, with ships.

It is not the literal land of Egypt, because you can walk to Egypt; Isaiah shows Israel walked down to Egypt. The false pastors who say we were shipped back across the Red Sea are wrong; the ships went to a spiritual Egypt.

Revelation names it: the great city which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt. The greatest country on the face of the earth, America, Babylon the great, is the Egypt we were carried into with ships.

Even their own scholarship confirms who was there the first time: a treatise on physical geography admits that negroes existed in Egypt in the days of Rameses with the same national features they have now. The Bible says the negroes go INTO Egypt, bondage, AGAIN.

There ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you: buy means redeem. Under the servitude laws a poor brother sold to a stranger could be redeemed by his uncle, his uncle's son, or any of his kin; but in this captivity none of your brothers can redeem you, because they are in bondage right along with you, as verse 29 already said: no man shall save thee.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

points: “if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes”. We fell because we wouldn't obey. “that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”. Christians who say we're not the Israelites would have to remove Deuteronomy 28 from the Bible, and we've got way more than that chapter.

note.label: Spiritual Uprising: When God Shakes a Nation

points: “And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. Egypt means captivity. Cargo slave ships. “by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again”. You aren't going to see your homeland again. “and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies”. When you get to those places, you'll be sold to enemies, not friends. “for bondmen and bondwomen”. Slave men and slave women.
I know this is AI. It doesn't matter if it's AI or not. The point is, did this happen? Yes.
Because a lot of time, a lot of us thinking it was just picking cotton. A lot of us get that mindset. Believe it or not, that's why all of us say, 'Oh, oh, we just picking cotton.' No, it was not.
Because some of you, some of you think Esau go to Africa, Esau take the dumbest slave. No, Esau know exactly who he was going to pick. He pick the best of us. And that's in the Bible. The best of us.

You think it's a coincidence? Think about it. Think about it. You think it's a coincidence what after slavery, Black Wall Street was successful like that? You think it's a coincidence? I want you to think cuz we have our own hospitals, our own school. Where is those doctors from? I want you to think.

It wasn't only Black Wall Street. All over America, here in Georgia. We had that successful black town. How does that happen in so short time? You never ask yourself that. Those men and women was not stupid. That's what that's saying. They was not stupid.
Cuz you know sometime you got to play video to refresh the to refresh the … mind.

note.label: Spiritual Uprising: When God Shakes a Nation

points: “if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God”. If we keep the law. “to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day”. All the laws, not some. “that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth”. That's the promise. Are we above all nations today? No. That tells you we broke the law. What you see now is us trying to come back.

Above all the nations is the goal, the kingdom of heaven. That's why we're here. Don't let a man, woman, or child take that away from you. What's coming is worth it. I want every nation under me. I want power. Lord willing, I won't let anyone take it. I've reached a point where I've got nothing to lose. Some of you are old men like me, maybe twenty or thirty years left. What have you got to lose? Why let a man take your crown?

note.label: Spiritual Uprising: When God Shakes a Nation

points: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”. Churches and urban apologists don't want you to know your enemy; they have that all-inclusive mentality. When do we fight for us? Hearing that whoever led us captive must go captive ought to ignite something, at least make you question it. Esau's movers and shakers have no problem understanding this. The inclusive ones in Birkenstocks and smoking patchouli aren't running anything. How many times must you or your people get clocked over the head before you see they don't like us? I'm not saying every one is like that, but the ones who aren't like that aren't fighting to change things. Don't feel bad about being Israelites or wearing fringes.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Look at a destroyed mind, or a mind used to destroy our people: that preacher says enslaved blacks didn't rally in Washington, good plantation people built churches and taught them to read the Bible, and 150 years ago they humbled themselves and prayed until white presidents ended slavery. I bet a black person agrees with him. You could drop dead. He's saying don't protest, stay weak, have no mind, be happy you were slaves.

Joshua, Jeremiah, Daniel—all the prophets were revolutionary, going against sin, immorality, and the nations. Daniel wouldn't bow to their gods. The American Revolution against Britain is celebrated with holidays because they wanted freedom from tyranny. What do you mean we didn't protest? Dred Scott went to the Supreme Court. What about Nat Turner and Denmark Vesey? We've always protested slavery. Christianity is foolish. That first-grade child pointing to the devil and calling him wicked—that's the mind our children should have.

The next men tell black people to grow up, stop whining about slavery, call living in America our reparations, and say otherwise we'd be in grass huts. They say the greatest moment for any brown or black country is when white ships arrive, bringing their gospel, hospitals, medicine, exports, longer life, GDP, and heaven. That makes you want to throw up. Devil, you stole Africa's resources to enrich Europe and America. Look at the land-grab map: Europe divided Africa and took its lands and resources. That continent made the world rich a thousand times over. We had civilizations while these dudes were in caves eating lice off their bodies in the Caucasus Mountains. That's their history, not something I'm making up. They stole America too. Church people leave their children stupid instead of equipping them with that truth. We aren't doing that.
